summary: The filled hull itself is new — no such notion in the pinned Mathlib or in TauCeti — and the width proof consumes Hahn–Banach and the convex-hull diameter API rather than rebuilding them. Three proof fragments in the normed file re-derive what earlier lines, an existing instance, or a sibling proof already provide.
